gen-gf-warnes-gf-port-lligat-sans: Port Lligat Sans packs tight, with bowls left open on one side. Port Lligat Sans keeps a long paragraph moving smoothly, since capitals and lowercase barely differ in height, while Warnes stretches out overhead.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-ramabhadra: Stretched out and loud: Warnes draws every curve without any weight shift. Ramabhadra stands out for its prominent x-height, clean sans-serif letters that stay large and legible beside the loud heading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-rambla: Rambla keeps its small letters almost as tall as capitals, which makes text look large. And where Warnes excels at loud, widely spaced display lines, Rambla excels at steady, compact text.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-recursive: Stretched, spacious tracking defines Warnes, with ink strokes that taper out before touching. Recursive takes over below with a tall mean line and strokes that keep their weight in every direction.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-roboto-condensed: Wide, loud, and inky, Warnes stretches its letters out. Roboto Condensed packs its enlarged lowercase into tight words with barely visible gaps, a line that glides along like wire.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Warnes brings bold, expressive letters with ink strokes that taper out before touching and generous, stretched spacing. Warnes earns its keep big and short; Saira Semi Condensed handles the rest.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-secular-one: Loud and stretched, Warnes draws bold ink strokes that taper out before touching, with no stroke contrast at all. Warnes shouts; Secular One fills lines with a dominant midsection.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-smooch-sans: Stretched, spacious, and boldly inked: that is Warnes up top. Smooch Sans packs a tight line with a high-set midline beneath it, while the heading's horizontals match its verticals.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Wide, loud, inky Warnes sets the tone with tapering strokes. Sofia Sans Condensed brings a large x-height and unshaded curves, making a long paragraph move along without fuss, in friendly plain sans letters.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-spline-sans-mono: Warnes stretches out wide, bold and inky. Spline Sans Mono, a monospace of fixed-width, code-style letters, keeps its lowercase nearly matching its capitals, a strict partner for the loose heading.
